findings.title: Shard path interpolates template variables twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now maps targets through datasource.applyTemplateVariables() at line 52, but the sub-request it builds is later passed to runSplitQuery() (shardQuerySplitting.ts line 163 -> querySplitting.ts line 296), which now also maps targets through applyTemplateVariables(). The same logical query is therefore interpolated twice, including re-application of request.filters ad-hoc filters. Template replacement is idempotent but ad-hoc filter injection is not, so the second pass can duplicate label matchers in the expr and change query semantics. The updated test expecting 5 calls instead of 1 confirms the double execution.
